CENTRAL REGISTRY
when finished with.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant
S.V.C.
Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 2
Date 1...k...ndr
January 2nd 1916

Sir,
The Tax Office in the City has notified all cash shops and banks that in future they will not be allowed to hang out signboards, unless they pay a fee. The Nantao Chamber of Commerce has sent a petition to the Central Government requesting the withdrawal of the new regulations.
The rice and bean shopkeepers in the City, having received notice that their taxes will be increased by 20 per cent, have petitioned the City Magistrate to wire to Peking and ask to have the new taxes withdrawn. The shopkeepers concerned have threatened to remove to the Settlement if their petition is ignored.
Eleven armed soldiers arrived in Shanghai from Nanking on 1st instant, and proceeded to the Arsenal by way of Chapei.
Three new year holidays have been granted to the soldiers at the Arsenal, but they are not permitted to leave barracks.
As a result of a fire which started at 3 a.m. 1st instant in the City, some seventy houses were burned to the ground. The French Brigade assisted in extinguishing the outbreak. The blaze which is reported to have been accidentally caused, started in a cigarette shop.

（批：Entered on
ms. Jan 3.
seen by C.I.P.）

Your Obedient Servant ,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 2 号
日期 1...k...ndr
1916年1月2日

先生：
城内税务局已通知所有现银庄及银行，今后除非缴纳费用，否则不得悬挂招牌。南市商会已向中央政府呈递请愿书，请求撤销此项新规。
城内米豆店店主在获悉税额将增加百分之二十后，已向城厢知事呈递请愿书，恳请致电北京，要求取消新税。相关店主威胁称，若其请愿被忽视，他们将迁往租界。
本月1日，十一名武装士兵从南京抵达上海，经闸北前往兵工厂。
兵工厂的士兵获准休假三天以度新年，但不得离开营房。
由于本月1日凌晨3时城内发生的一场火灾，约七十间房屋被焚毁。法国巡捕队协助扑灭了火势。据报道，这场大火系意外引起，起火点为一家香烟店。

（批注：录入于
手稿 1月3日。
已由首席督察阅悉）

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处警司
